answer: Each island issues one trust root per verified person. A root gets one vote with one vertex-disjoint support path, two votes with two paths, three with four, doubling thereafter, regardless of its key count. Every path burns one ivory and consumes a different root’s single-use echo. Ten effective clones thus cost 512 ivory plus bribes to 512 other people; the tenth vote adds 256 of each. Extra keys stay on that root, and new wallets cannot divide its paths. An honest root’s first vote burns one ivory.
